current_prompt.body:
IMPLEMENT a web scraper that
  GIVEN an HTML page,
  EXTRACT all hyperlink URLs from the page,
  RETURN the list of links.

current_plan.body:
PARSE the provided HTML document into a DOM representation
FOR EACH anchor element in the DOM
    EXTRACT the href attribute value
    IF the href attribute exists
        ADD the extracted URL to the results list
RETURN the results list
